description: This pie chart visually represents four key attributes or dimensions of a benchmarking framework for LLMs, each occupying one quadrant of the circle: “Complexity” (yellow, with a ladder icon), “Instance” (light blue, with a shield icon), “Coverage” (green, with a globe and gear icon), and “Scalable Oversight” (red, with a checklist icon). Each quadrant is labeled with a descriptive term and an associated icon, and the chart is surrounded by four rectangular callouts—“Unhackable” (top right), “General” (bottom right), “Auto-verifiable” (bottom left), and “Complexity” (top left)—which appear to be properties or goals associated with the respective quadrant. The chart does not display percentage values or a legend, and the segments are not exploded or otherwise visually emphasized. The quadrants are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top left, and while the chart is divided into four equal parts, the visual presentation suggests a balanced distribution of these four core attributes.
